bead.title: bench-pr-A3c: --max-cost-usd budget enforcement + budget.json + budget_halted placeholder
bead.description:
PROBLEM: A2 produces reports with profile.pricing but does not tally cost, so sweeps cannot be cost-capped. There is no typed placeholder for cells skipped due to budget exhaustion.

ROOT CAUSE:
  - scripts/benchmark/benchmark (A2): no aggregation pass between cells; pricing data sits in report.json unused.
  - No <out>/budget.json convention exists.

PROPOSED FIX:
  1. --max-cost-usd FLOAT flag (default unset = unlimited).
  2. At each cell close: compute cost_usd_at_run_time = profile.pricing × token streams from report.json; append {cell_id,cost_usd} to <out>/budget.json by_cell; update total_usd.
  3. Track per-cell max_estimated_next_cost (rolling max of completed cells, fallback to a small floor if none completed).
  4. Before scheduling next cell: if total_usd + max_estimated_next_cost > --max-cost-usd, halt scheduling.
  5. Each unscheduled remaining cell gets a placeholder report.json with final_status="budget_halted", process_outcome="setup_failed", note="budget cap reached".
  6. budget.json fields strictly typed (numbers, not strings).

NON-SCOPE (preserved from parent):
  - cell-report.schema.json (PR B); bench-set schema (PR C)
  - Node collector/importers (PR D/E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G)
  - Harbor image, shell adapters, agent-leak fix (A1)
  - Bash runner core, --plan, report.json composition (A2)
  - Parity fixtures + diff.sh (A4)
  - flock / --jobs / in-flight.json (A3a)
  - Signal handling and docker cleanup (A3b)
  - cmd/bench redirect (A3d)

GOVERNING: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification. Depends on A2.

ACCEPTANCE:
  1. test_runner_budget.sh::test_max_cost_usd_produces_budget_halted — `./benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary --max-cost-usd 0.01`; at least one cell exists with final_status=="budget_halted", process_outcome=="setup_failed", note populated. <out>/budget.json total_usd ≤ 0.01 + last_completed_cell_cost.
  2. test_runner_budget.sh::test_budget_json_accumulates — budget.json by_cell sum equals total_usd; field types validated as numeric.
  3. test_runner_budget.sh::test_no_cap_no_halt — without --max-cost-usd, no cells are budget_halted regardless of cost.

GATES: `go test ./...` green; `lefthook run pre-commit` green; `bash scripts/benchmark/test/run.sh`.
bead.acceptance: All 3 ACs pass; satisfies parent AC3; go test + lefthook gates green.
